reviewed_context_transfers.basis: Native instruction bodies match the reviewed same-release Lua context boundaries byte for byte through their transfer instruction.

reviewed_virtual_owner_calls.basis: Deleting destructor slot and reference-count guarded control-block release preserve the native owner argument.

reviewed_constant_pool_aliases.basis: Immutable scalar aliases of native literal-pool words plus reviewed PC constants resolve into initialized module data.

reviewed_decimal_float_returns.basis: Native strtod and strtof return IEEE bits through the ARM soft-float R0/R1 boundary; callers store the low return word rather than an unbound decompiler temporary.

reviewed_scalar_double_value.basis: Native VMOV R0/R1 receives a signed-int conversion from offset 4, float conversion from offset 8, or boolean at offset 12. Invalid scalar tags retain the recovered exception path.

_wm_probe_heap_add_region.declaration: bool add_region(unsigned long address,unsigned long size);

_wm_probe_heap_add_regions.declaration: bool add_regions(unsigned long *addresses,unsigned long *sizes,unsigned long count);

_wm_probe_heap_alloc_range.declaration: void *alloc_range(unsigned long size,unsigned long first,unsigned long last);

reviewed_decimal_word_arguments.basis: Native float-to-double promotion is followed by VMOV into the formatter integer word arguments. Ghidra SUB84 and integral casts are bit extraction, rather than numeric conversion.
